newsitem.title: USA: Fonar receives $128.7 million from GE.
newsitem.headline: Fonar receives $128.7 million from GE.

text.p: Medical diagnostic equipment maker Fonar Corp. said Wednesday it had received $128.7 million from General Electric Co., representing a judgment plus interest against GE in a patent infringement case.
A federal jury awarded Fonar $103 million in 1995. The jury found GE had violated two Fonar patents, including a cancer detection patent.
In May, the U.S. Supreme Court denied GE's motion to stay payment of the award pending appeal to the court.
Fonar said payment of the judgment does not preclude GE appealing to the Supreme Court, GE's only remaining recourse.
Fonar, based in Melville, N.Y., sued GE in 1992. The company makes magnetic resonance imaging scanners.
Fonar's stock edged up 6 cents to $3.06 on Nasdaq in early afternoon trading. GE rose 25 cents to $66.44 on the New York Stock Exchange.
